final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS c FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.bats AS bats, s1.c AS c, s1.c * 1.0 / s2.total AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS avg_c FROM s3) SELECT s3.bats, s3.c, s3.share, s3.c - s4.avg_c AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_c IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.c > s4.avg_c
